shots.name: gaussian-blur-inspector
shots.alt: Properties, Effects with a Gaussian Blur card: the Preset menu showing Out of Focus and the Radius row at 10 px, beside a strip of the preview where the harbour town has gone soft
shots.caption: Gaussian Blur at its default, which is also the Out of Focus preset. 1 — Preset: pick a starting point. 2 — Radius: how soft the picture gets.

shots.name: gaussian-blur-nodes
shots.alt: The Nodes tab with the clip picked as its source: the clip's image source, the folded Gaussian Blur card with the › left of its title, and the output

marks.label: pick the clip here (the tab starts on the whole Timeline)

shots.name: box-blur-inspector
shots.alt: Properties, Effects with a Box Blur card: the Preset menu showing Square Lights and the Radius row at 20 px, beside a strip of the preview where the neon lights have turned into soft squares
shots.caption: Box Blur with the Square Lights preset. 1 — Preset: pick a starting point. 2 — Radius: how far the softening reaches.

shots.name: motion-blur-inspector
shots.alt: Properties, Effects with a Motion Blur card: the Preset menu showing Falling, the Length row at 4% and the Angle row at 90°, beside a strip of the preview where the lights of the night street run down in vertical streaks
shots.caption: Motion Blur with the Falling preset. 1 — Preset: pick a starting point. 2 — Length: how far the streak reaches. 3 — Angle: which way it points.

shots.name: radial-blur-inspector
shots.alt: Properties, Effects with a Radial Blur card: the Preset menu showing Whirlpool, Type on Spin, Amount at 1.5 and Center X and Center Y at 0.5, beside a strip of the preview where the night street turns into rings of light around the walker
shots.caption: Radial Blur with the Whirlpool preset. 1 — Preset: pick a starting point. 2 — Type: streaks towards the centre or circles around it. 3 — Amount: how strong. 4 — Center X: where the sharp middle sits across. 5 — Center Y: and up or down.

shots.name: zoom-blur-inspector
shots.alt: Properties, Effects with a Zoom Blur card: the Preset menu showing Rush, Amount at 0.45 and Center X and Center Y at 0.5, beside a strip of the preview where the dancer's arm and dress and a beam of stage light streak outward from the middle of the frame
shots.caption: Zoom Blur with the Rush preset. 1 — Preset: pick a starting point. 2 — Amount: how long the streaks are. 3 — Center X: where the burst starts across. 4 — Center Y: and up or down.
